summary: Revision 6 has exact current plan, contract, source, document and approval bindings and a sound bounded AC-8 design. One execution-scope contradiction must be corrected before dependent dispatch: the increment prohibits all service/network activity while directing every retained check to run, although several checks intentionally start synthetic local services, perform loopback requests or may install from a registry. This review does not authorize a real SDK host or attest implementation behavior.

open_findings.title: Reconcile the blanket effect prohibition with the retained check commands
evidence: plan.md:34 says not to start a service or make network requests; line 36 requires all 12 existing checks plus the new focused check against the settled fingerprint.
contract.json retains install = pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, which can mutate dependency state/contact a registry and does not itself establish a clean installation.
apps/workbench-web/playwright.config.ts starts the fixture bridge on 127.0.0.1:5318 and Vite on 127.0.0.1:5420; its E2E check therefore necessarily starts services and uses loopback requests.
apps/local-bridge/scripts/operations-drill.mjs starts loopback bridge listeners, fetches their endpoints, creates a synthetic child process, and writes owned temporary markers.

next-runtime-proposal-r1.md already distinguishes these existing-check effects, but runtime-info-boundary.md:3 explicitly says that proposal does not amend the plan; the executable SSOT has not adopted that distinction.
open_findings.impact: A clean-context implementer or check runner cannot satisfy both instructions as written. Treating the broad prohibition as an unstated exception could widen execution authority; treating it literally prevents required evidence. The no-install boundary in the new design contract also needs to remain distinct from the retained installation check.
open_findings.required_correction: Make the plan explicitly distinguish the pure AC-8 implementation and SDK probe prohibition from the already authorized existing regression commands. Adopt a concise exact check/effect table (the proposal supplies a suitable starting point), naming existing fixture processes, loopback requests, temporary writes and installation preconditions. Preserve all required checks, forbid new SDK host/ambient-service/config/credential effects, and keep absent spike dependencies as a blocker rather than permission to install or change packages. State that pnpm install --frozen-lockfile is clean-install evidence only when its clean starting condition is separately recorded. No new user approval is needed merely to document already authorized checks. Refresh the plan revision, the runtime-info document plan-hash reference, document/contract hashes, packet and independent changed-concern reviews together.

observations: All packet hashes match disk: plan 3f6aa2aba5ab9af559ae75b9153777974e367eb57daeab3dbe7096c81f95e28e; contract cd7d81250a6877fefb57872c1e969b8a84c27af982c2c7fa9ad990e2f4a12301; source 15c4f3a092de964e4b816d36a3a903f552d82fb48e98d19e504f281a56bccd8d. Source inventory was independently recomputed using the harness v2 inclusion/mode/hash rules without invoking the harness.

All 10 registered document hashes and both approval target/evidence hashes match. The runtime-info design document currently cites exactly the revision-6 plan hash; there is no stale revision/hash reference in that document at review time.

Five implementation paths are exact and bounded; the three planned new files do not yet exist. Existing spike verify.mjs and its typecheck configuration can wire the new shared-source probe without package or topology changes. Root tsx and the pinned client dependency are present; no dependency installation was attempted.

The 13 required checks have literal argv and cwd values; existing Nx target names and spike check wiring resolve in static project files. The new runtime-info command intentionally awaits its planned test file. Existing checks remain partial synthetic evidence, not full product/runtime readiness.

The own-data-property admission rules, bounded primitive checks, fresh version-only copy, invalid-schema versus read-failure outcomes, discarded PID/URL/path authority, no-retry one-read wrapper, Proxy caveat, canary cases and diagnostic version omission are sufficient for this bounded implementation. Failure reports must preserve the stated redaction even when assertions fail; implementation review remains necessary.

The new boundary introduces no browser route, health claim, authentication classification, SDK production import, UI provenance change or new user-facing product feature. Existing permission state/action and receipt contracts remain authoritative.

Future host lifecycle, configuration/credential isolation, owned process/socket/temp-root effects, cleanup, storage/retention choices, S-08 security, real deny admission and S-09 recovery remain explicit holds. A plan/design pass would not authorize real host startup.

Minor consistency edit to make with the required plan correction: plan.md:38 groups the two checks under AC-2/4/6/8, whereas the contract assigns sdk-client-probe to AC-2/4/7/8 and runtime-info-boundary to AC-2/4/6/8. State the two exact mappings separately; retain the existing AC-7 mapping.
